name: Expert_ADC_PL_MFI
summary: This EA uses a custom signal filter based on the Market Facilitation Index (MFI) combined with a Moving Average to generate trading signals within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework. It employs fixed lot sizing with no trailing stop, relying solely on the CDC_PL_MFI signal filter for entry and exit decisions with configurable thresholds.
summary_zh: 该EA使用基于市场促进指数(MFI)与移动平均线组合的自定义信号过滤器，在MQL5标准库EA框架内生成交易信号。它采用固定手数仓位管理，不使用追踪止损，完全依赖CDC_PL_MFI信号过滤器进行入场和出场决策。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于MFI（市场促进指数）指标和其移动平均线的组合信号过滤器CDC_PL_MFI。入场条件由MFI周期（默认49）和MA周期（默认11）共同决定，当信号强度超过开仓阈值（默认10）时触发交易。出场条件同样依赖信号过滤器的反向信号强度超过平仓阈值，同时设有固定止损（50点）和止盈（50点）水平。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（默认0.1手），不进行动态仓位调整。资金管理使用CMoneyFixedLot类，按固定百分比（10%）和固定手数进行控制。整体策略属于动量类，利用MFI指标衡量市场资金流入流出力度并结合MA平滑来判断趋势方向和交易时机。该EA没有使用追踪止损，止损止盈相对较紧（50点），且挂单设有4根K线的过期时间。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a custom signal filter CDC_PL_MFI that combines the Market Facilitation Index (MFI) indicator with its Moving Average. Entry conditions are determined by the MFI period (default 49) and MA period (default 11), triggering trades when signal strength exceeds the opening threshold (default 10). Exit conditions similarly rely on the signal filter's reverse signal strength exceeding the closing threshold, with fixed stop loss (50 points) and take profit (50 points) levels in place. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (default 0.1 lots) without dynamic adjustment. Money management employs the CMoneyFixedLot class, controlling risk via a fixed percentage (10%) and fixed lot size. The overall strategy falls under the momentum category, leveraging the MFI indicator to measure market money flow intensity combined with MA smoothing to judge trend direction and trading opportunities. The EA does not use trailing stops, has relatively tight stop loss and take profit (50 points), and pending orders have a 4-bar expiration time.

parameters.name: Expert_MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

parameters.name: Expert_EveryTick
parameters.description: 是否每个Tick都执行交易逻辑
parameters.description_en: Execute trading logic on every tick

pros: 基于MFI指标的动量策略逻辑清晰，MFI能有效衡量市场资金流入流出力度
使用MQL5标准库Expert框架，代码结构规范、模块化程度高，易于维护和扩展
设有固定止损止盈（50点），风险可控，不会出现无止损的危险情况
信号权重可调，允许灵活控制信号过滤器对整体交易决策的影响程度
采用每根K线而非每个Tick执行逻辑（Expert_EveryTick=false），减少过度交易
pros_en: Clear momentum strategy logic based on MFI indicator, which effectively measures market money flow intensity
Uses MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework with well-structured, modular code that is easy to maintain and extend
Fixed stop loss and take profit (50 points) in place, keeping risk controlled without dangerous stopless positions
Adjustable signal weight allows flexible control over the signal filter's influence on overall trading decisions
Per-bar execution rather than per-tick (Expert_EveryTick=false) reduces overtrading
cons: 止损止盈均为固定50点，未考虑市场波动率（ATR）动态调整，在不同品种和周期上可能不适用
没有追踪止损机制（使用TrailingNone），盈利头寸无法跟随趋势获取更大利润
仅依赖单一信号过滤器，缺乏多维度信号确认，容易产生虚假信号导致的亏损交易
固定手数0.1手未根据账户资金和风险动态调整，在不同资金规模下风险暴露不一致
MFI周期49和MA周期11的默认参数缺乏说明，无法判断是否经过充分回测优化
cons_en: Fixed 50-point stop loss and take profit without ATR-based dynamic adjustment may not suit all instruments and timeframes
No trailing stop mechanism (uses TrailingNone), preventing profitable positions from riding trends for larger gains
Relies on a single signal filter without multi-dimensional confirmation, making it vulnerable to false signals and resulting losses
Fixed 0.1 lot sizing doesn't dynamically adjust based on account equity and risk, leading to inconsistent risk exposure across different account sizes
Default MFI period 49 and MA period 11 lack documentation, making it unclear whether they were adequately backtested and optimized
improvements: 将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态调整，以适应不同市场波动环境
增加追踪止损模块替代TrailingNone，使盈利头寸能够锁定利润并跟随趋势
添加多时间框架确认或多信号过滤器组合，提高入场信号的可靠性
improvements_en: Replace fixed stop loss/take profit with ATR-based dynamic adjustment to adapt to different market volatility environments
Add a trailing stop module to replace TrailingNone, allowing profitable positions to lock in gains and follow trends
Add multi-timeframe confirmation or combine multiple signal filters to improve entry signal reliability

risk_points: 固定止损止盈50点在低波动品种上可能过宽导致较大亏损，在高波动品种上可能过窄导致频繁止损
单一信号过滤器缺乏确认机制，可能产生较多虚假信号
risk_points_en: Fixed 50-point SL/TP may be too wide on low-volatility instruments causing larger losses, or too narrow on high-volatility instruments causing frequent stop-outs
Single signal filter without confirmation mechanism may generate excessive false signals

It employs fixed lot sizing with no trailing stop, relying solely on the CDC_PL_MFI signal filter for entry and exit decisions with configurable thresholds.
